in_arabic.name: مصننف
in_arabic.long_meaning: Someone who gathers or collects things, or someone who compiles or edits works. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'sanana', which means 'to gather' or 'to collect'.

in_urdu.name: Musannaf
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Collector or Compiler of Hadiths
in_urdu.long_meaning: Musannaf ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Musannaf refers to a person who collects, compiles, or records Hadiths (authentic sayings and actions of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)). It is a title of respect given to individuals who dedicate their lives to preserving the teachings and traditions of Islam.
